text:
Lina: Heads-up - Helix Health SI reported failures during private deploy: serve crashes under long sequences and their air-gapped registry rejects our marketplace image signature. Need quick arch + marketplace sync.

Owen: Can you paste the crash tail and exact image tag?

Lina: Crash tail:
```
2026-03-20T14:05:12Z stderr: runtime: out of memory allocating 134217728
service: redwood-serve
model: redwood-open-7b-q4_0
container: helix/redwood-serve:v2026-02-18-repacked
node: p3dn.24xlarge
```
And registry error: "rdw-verify: annotation missing: signature"

Priya: If they repackaged the image, OCI annotations/signatures can be stripped. Ask for `docker images --digests` and the sha256 they imported. Also DM their SRE the signed tarball link.

Owen: On arch side: lower max_seq and enable KV prefix caching as temp mitigation: `--max-seq 2048 --rdw-kv-cache=on`. Also request `rdw-runtime-check` output from their nodes.

Lina: Marketplace bot - can you generate a presigned S3 link to the signed v2026-02-18 tarball for air-gapped use?

marketplace-bot: Presigned link created: https://s3.redwood.ai/signed/redwood-serve-v2026-02-18.tar.gz?X (expires in 24h). Ticket MKT-7700 opened for entitlement if needed.

Priya: Added compliance note: if Helix needs HIPAA, ensure BAA on file before dedicated peering. I've attached the checklist to MKT-7700.

Lina: Action items for SI: 1) revert to signed image or import tarball from S3, 2) run `rdw-runtime-check` and attach output, 3) try `--max-seq 2048 --rdw-kv-cache=on` and report alloc logs. We'll follow up on the call at 30m.

Owen: I'll draft a rollback playbook for one node and post it after the call.
